{{Quote|Observation: If that Hutt had only known my true function, he surely would not have sold me to a senator he bribed regularly.|HK-47|<ref name="KOTORg" />}}
This '''Hutt''' was a rival of fellow [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Bochaba]]. Residing on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sleheyron/Legends|Sleheyron]], the Hutt was a [[Gender/Legends|male]]. When the [[Exchange]] crime syndicate had Bochaba [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] he claimed his [[Death/Legends|deceased]] rival's possessions, including the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] known as [[HK-47]]. The Hutt was not aware of HK-47's assassination functions and sold the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to a [[Unidentified Human senator|Senator]] who he frequently bribed.<ref name="KOTORg" />

==Behind the scenes==
This Hutt was mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'', a [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], during conversation with HK-47.
